$Comment: The Magic Ruins kit, piece C_Small_Medium: every prefab under Dungeon.Magic_Ruins.C_Small.Medium, 6 interchangeable variants.

Imported from vanilla's cave-node graph Dungeons/Dungeon_Magic_Ruins (8 nodes use this pool) by tools/rooms/import_kit.py. Re-run the importer when Hytale changes the kit instead of editing this file.
Each door is a doorway vanilla's graph joins to another piece; a door only meets a door of its own Kind, and one left open takes a Cap room of that Kind.
Vanilla pastes these pieces into solid rock, so Fill (Rock_Quartzite) fills the cells a piece leaves unlisted inside its Box.
